related.title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」與「原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；EUV 多層膜反射鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries" and "In-situ wavefront metrology and Zernike decomposition" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of EUV multilayer mirrors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從 Rayleigh 解析度到折反射浸潤鏡頭的像差、熱漂移與套刻預算；EUV 多層膜反射鏡則以13.5 nm 反射式光學的多層膜、面形、污染與波前預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from Rayleigh resolution to aberration, thermal drift and overlay budgets of catadioptric immersion lenses; EUV multilayer mirrors centres on multilayer reflectance, figure, contamination and wavefront budgets for 13.5 nm reflective optics, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」與「反射式光路與真空腔」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到EUV 多層膜反射鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Projection-lens NA and image space” and “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to EUV multilayer mirrors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

以「載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Projection-lens NA and image space” and “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ASML 微影投影光學工程
history.text: 1980 年代的步進機以全折射 g-line 與 i-line 鏡頭成像，1990 年代步進掃描機以縫隙掃描把視場擴大到 26×33 mm；ASML 與蔡司在 2000 年代把 ArF 鏡頭推進到折反射浸潤架構，NA 1.35 的 TWINSCAN NXT 系列從 2007 年前後成為先進製程主力，之後由 13.5 nm 的 NXE 與 NA 0.55 的 High-NA EXE 接續。Nikon 與 Canon 也各自發展浸潤與 i-line 投影鏡頭。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何專有設計。
history.textEn: Steppers of the 1980s imaged with all-refractive g-line and i-line lenses, and 1990s step-and-scan systems enlarged the field to 26×33 mm by scanning a slit; ASML and ZEISS advanced ArF lenses to catadioptric immersion layouts in the 2000s, and the NA 1.35 TWINSCAN NXT series became the workhorse of advanced nodes from around 2007, later joined by the 13.5 nm NXE and the NA 0.55 High-NA EXE. Nikon and Canon developed their own immersion and i-line projection lenses. This course reconstructs public physics and engineering logic only, not any proprietary design.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」到「系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries" through "System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
